title: Planting Tomatoes Correctly in New Jersey

subtasks.task_text: Describe the timing and preparation for planting a tomato.
subtasks.text: Wait until after the last frost date, which is May 15th, to plant tomatoes.

logic.thread_summary: The subtasks discuss the optimal time to plant tomatoes based on the last frost date.

logical_links.link: The subtask provides the specific date to start planting tomatoes, which is crucial for their growth and survival.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the technique for preparing the tomato for planting.
subtasks.text: Remove lower leaves and stems from the tomato, leaving only the top growth.

subtasks.task_text: Highlight the use of eggshells in planting tomatoes.
subtasks.text: Break up one to two eggshells and place them in the planting hole.

logic.thread_summary: The video segment describes the process of preparing tomato plants for planting by removing lower leaves, and then breaking up eggshells to use as a planting amendment.

logical_links.link: After removing the lower leaves and stems, the next step is to prepare the planting hole by breaking up eggshells to provide nutrients to the tomato plant.

bridging_sentences.text: This helps the plant focus on growing strong roots and foliage.

subtasks.task_text: Describe the importance of proper mulch for tomato growth.
subtasks.text: Use straw mulch, not wood mulch, as it robs nutrients from tomato plants.

logic.thread_summary: The video segment discusses the appropriate type of mulch to use for tomato plants and explains why certain types are better than others.

logical_links.link: The subtask directly states the recommendation for mulching tomato plants, explaining the reasoning behind the choice.

subtasks.task_text: Explain the watering technique for newly planted tomatoes.
subtasks.text: Water newly planted tomatoes with one good soaking per week.

logic.thread_summary: Instructions on how to properly water newly planted tomatoes.

logical_links.link: The subtask directly provides watering instructions for newly planted tomatoes, which is the main topic.
